name: Answer goal and emit concept
description: User-dispatch terminal template: takes a free-form goal, has an LLM ANSWER it directly (not paraphrase it), then mints a concept in concept-db whose `content` holds the answer and whose `summary` is a one-line distillation. This shape lets the obsidian-vessel goal note become a usable knowledge artifact — the user reads the produced concept and gets an answer, not a restatement of their question. The minted concept produces a concept:created lifecycle event in concept-db, which the bus forwards to activity-api /v2/events/publish and onward to the WebSocket broadcaster as `concept.created` (unprefixed, per the consumer contract). `execution_id` is threaded through `conceptData.execution_id` (interpolated from the engine's {{executionId}} accumulated variable) into the published event's `data.execution_id` so the GoalDispatchView can attribute the mint to the dispatched root execution. SCHEMA: matches resolver+config schema used by ribosome-extract / draft-gap-closing-activity (llm_completion_dispatch + http_fetch).

variables.name: goal
variables.description: Free-form goal text from the user. Auto-populated by GoalHost.runGoal from the request body's `goal` field.

variables.name: summaryMaxTokens
variables.description: Token budget for the summarize task's LLM call (informational; the task config currently hardcodes max_tokens=300 because the engine's variable interpolation does not propagate template-level defaults into config fields).

tasks.description: Search concept-db for concepts related to the goal. Returns a JSON list of related concepts (id + summary). Used to ground the answer in prior knowledge — each answered goal becomes context for future answers, so the substrate's answers improve as the concept graph fills in. failOnNon2xx is false: an empty result set is normal on cold start and must not fail the chain.
tasks.notes: concept-db's /concepts/search runs FTS over the concept content/summary. The full goal text is sent verbatim as q= (URL-encoded by the fetch layer). Top 5 results are returned. The bodyText (JSON-stringified search result) becomes {{retrieve_context_text}} for the next task. No auth required for read-side.

tasks.description: Grep /workspace/memory (operator-imported notes and prior findings) for the goal text. Targets a narrow, high-signal subtree because the broader /workspace contains 50k+ files (proposals, patches, validation runs) and would time out under fs_grep's per-file 512KiB read. Returns up to 15 line-level matches; node_modules / .git / non-text extensions are skipped. Empty result is acceptable on a fresh substrate — the answer step proceeds with concept-db context only.
tasks.notes: Memory dir holds the operator's auto-memory notes (user/feedback/project/reference types) imported by import-operator-memory.ts. These are the highest-signal local artifacts for grounding goal-answers — they describe what the operator knows, what conventions exist, and prior decisions/percolations. Future enhancement: a search-online resolver (web_search) would slot in as a sibling task — give the LLM cross-source context without changing the answer task's prompt structure. Broader-tree search (super-repo source) requires loosening fs_grep's workspace-root guard OR adding a separate code_grep resolver scoped to mounted repo paths.

tasks.description: Use Anthropic's native server-side web_search tool to look up authoritative external sources for the goal topic. Runs via llm_completion_dispatch in tool-use mode: the model decides whether to search, the search runs INSIDE Anthropic (no external API key needed beyond ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), and the model produces a synthesized prose summary citing the URLs it consulted. failOnNon2xx is implicit through llm-resolver-vessel — a failed Anthropic call returns resolved:false and the chain continues with empty web context.
tasks.notes: web_search is a built-in Anthropic server-side tool: invoked as `{type: 'web_search_20250305', name: 'web_search'}`. Anthropic runs the search inside its API and returns results inline; llm-resolver-vessel passes the tools array through verbatim and skips client-side dispatch for any tool def carrying a `type` field. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is the only credential needed. Limits: max_uses caps Anthropic's search budget per call; max_tool_iterations caps llm-resolver-vessel's loop. The model is instructed to skip search entirely for purely substrate-internal goals (where the concept-db + fs_grep grounding is already authoritative) — this avoids spurious web calls on operator-internal questions.

tasks.description: Ask an LLM to ANSWER the user goal directly, grounded in concept-db context, local file matches, AND web search results. Plain text only, no quotes/backslashes/newlines (the answer is inlined into a JSON string downstream). 2-5 sentences. If the goal is a question, give the answer. If it is a request to describe/explain/summarize a topic, do so substantively. If ALL grounding sources are empty or unhelpful, answer from training knowledge but acknowledge the limit (e.g. 'Without prior concepts on this topic:' prefix).
tasks.notes: Answer text is propagated to the emit_concept task via {{answer_text}} (the engine's accumulatedVariables convention exposes the resolver's primary text output under <taskId>_text). The same text becomes both the concept's content (full body) and summary (concept-db will truncate summary if needed). The prompt forbids quotes/backslashes/newlines so direct inlining into a JSON string field is safe, AND requires the 'Without prior concepts on this topic:' prefix only when BOTH grounding sources are empty (concept-db + file matches) so the user can see when an answer is ungrounded. fs_grep file matches let the answer cite concrete paths instead of generic claims; concept-db context provides accumulated knowledge across prior goals.

tasks.description: Mint a concept in concept-db via http_fetch POST to /v2/impulses/resolve with pointer.type=concept_create_write. content = answer text (the substantive answer), summary = same answer text (concept-db caps summary at ~280 chars). source_type=goal matches SourceTypeSchema enum.
tasks.notes: The http_fetch resolver auto-attaches METABOB_API_KEY on substrate-local POSTs (see http-fetch.ts V28 gating) and, with failOnNon2xx: true, surfaces concept-db 4xx/5xx as task failures instead of silently registering green. concept-db's resolver emits a concept:created lifecycle event which the bus forwards to activity-api /v2/events/publish → WS broadcaster as type=concept.created (unprefixed). {{answer_text}} and {{goal}} are inlined directly into the JSON body; the upstream answer prompt forbids double-quotes/backslashes/newlines so this is safe in the common case. metadata.goal is captured for provenance (the answer alone may lose what was originally asked).
